rows.note: This is the all-purpose attributive construction for something that has been estimated rather than measured exactly.

example.english: This is an estimated figure, not an exact figure.
example.traditional: 呢個係估計嘅數字，唔係準確數字。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 gu2 gai3 ge3 sou3 zi6 m4 hai6 zeon2 kok3 sou3 zi6
